items.title: Finite modules over a local ring have projective covers
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a finite module over a local ring admits a projective cover (author lemma at source lines 658-662, label lemma-projective-covers-local). The proof (source lines 664-673) chooses a minimal set of generators, uses Nakayama's lemma for surjectivity and again to show that no proper submodule maps onto the target, which is essentialness (proof lines 664-672). The double use of Nakayama is the substance. H3.
